mathematical_contract.common_circle: Both retained maps were produced as positive-length overlaps with the same selected algebraic cusp semicircle. Their target images therefore lie on one already-certified supporting circle; coordinate coincidence is not inferred independently.
mathematical_contract.correspondence: The bivariate equation cross(T_source(t),T_target(s))=0 is built from exact rational homogeneous tangent numerators or exact analytic-parallel tangent numerators. An exact source parameter specializes this equation directly. An algebraic source parameter is projected with the existing selected-root local-field fiber authority in Hypersolve.
mathematical_contract.uniqueness: Parallel tangent directions on one circle identify a point and its antipode. A selected open semicircle contains at most one of them. The caller has already compared the requested cusp cut unequal to both overlap endpoints, so this fallback selects only the strict interior of the published target cell; endpoint mappings remain handled by the earlier exact endpoint authority.
mathematical_contract.regularity: Coincident overlap construction partitions carriers at angular stationary events. A zero target derivative therefore cannot occur inside a published regular cell. Singular endpoint parameters introduced by reparameterizations such as t=s^2 are excluded by strict-interior selection without a second high-degree sign or GCD pass.
mathematical_contract.reversal: A reversed overlap retains the forward parameter map and one reversal bit. Candidate isolation stays in the original parameterization, then exact unit complement maps the unique result into the reversed target range.
mathematical_contract.policy: Every coefficient sign, resultant projection, root isolation, root membership, ordering, range, and equality predicate receives CurveContext. STRICT accepts exact proof only. APPROXIMATE_512 follows the identical graph and may terminate only at the shared 512-bit predicate boundary while reporting consumed approximate certainty.
mathematical_contract.failure: A mismatched policy, degenerate tangent relation, unresolved selected-root projection, absent interior candidate, or multiple candidates remains explicit. No f64 conversion, sampling, tolerance, primitive-element equality, uncorrelated root matching, or finite projection is used.
